phases.label: Frame destination
phases.description: Define the observable destination, success conditions, constraints, scope, and authority boundaries.

phases.label: Resolve route
phases.description: Turn fog into precise decisions and settle destination-blocking route choices.

phases.label: Prove route
phases.description: Validate material assumptions, establish feasibility, and define delivery gates.

phases.label: Ready for execution
phases.description: Perform the final consistency and exit review and create the completion handoff.

phases.label: Delivery & revalidation
phases.description: Evaluate gates during delivery and revalidate only after failure, staleness, or material change.

checkpoints.label: Destination framing review
checkpoints.due_when: The destination and boundaries are first written or materially revised.
checkpoints.reason: Run Wayfinder after the destination and boundaries are first framed or materially revised.

checkpoints.label: Decision-route review
checkpoints.due_when: A destination-blocking route decision is actionable or its prerequisite settles.
checkpoints.reason: Resume Wayfinder while destination-blocking route decisions remain unsettled.

checkpoints.label: Evidence and feasibility review
checkpoints.due_when: Material evidence arrives, a high-impact assumption changes, or recorded evidence becomes stale.
checkpoints.reason: Run Wayfinder when material evidence arrives, an assumption changes, or route evidence expires.

checkpoints.label: Execution handoff review
checkpoints.due_when: The route appears decision-complete and is about to enter its domain-appropriate execution plan.
checkpoints.reason: Run Wayfinder immediately before the route is handed to execution.

checkpoints.label: Delivery revalidation
checkpoints.due_when: A Gate fails or becomes stale, delivery contradicts a route premise, or the destination or route materially changes.
checkpoints.reason: Do not rerun during routine delivery; revalidate only after a failed or stale Gate or material change.

milestones.label: Destination baseline
criteria: Observable success conditions, constraints, scope, and authority boundaries are explicit.

milestones.label: Decision-complete route
criteria: Destination-blocking route Decisions are formulated and resolved.

milestones.label: Evidence-sufficient route
criteria: Material assumptions and feasibility claims have fresh evidence, and delivery Gates are defined.

milestones.label: Completion handoff
criteria: The exit contract passes and EXIT.md records the accepted route.

milestones.label: Delivery milestone
criteria: Delivery evaluates defined Gates; failures and staleness target linked Decisions for revalidation.
